The page states NoiPA is the platform built by the DAG of the MEF for managing public-administration personnel, matching the printed operator exactly.
The same verbatim sentence names NoiPA as the platform for managing PA personnel, which supports the printed register name.

Both quotes are verbatim; the ACN cloud regulation's Annex 2 requirement 2_O states that the administration's data are processed on infrastructure located in EU territory, a binding regulatory requirement for EU jurisdiction, and the normattiva art. 33-septies text adds the national-territory infrastructure provision.

The regulation (art. 17) restricts 'strategic' data and services to QC3/QC4 qualified cloud services, and Annex 2 strategic-level requirements (6_S, 8_S) only require notifying ACN of non-EU-entity access requests, granting it solely with the administration's explicit authorisation, and EU-located metadata, not full immunity from non-EU law; a qualification scheme is in force with partial immunity

The strategy page says ACN Regulation 21007/2024 establishes the procedures for classifying PA data and services (quote verbatim apart from a tag-induced space before a comma), and the regulation itself classifies data and services into three classes, so the classification scheme sits in a binding regulation.

The ADM Libro blu 2024 says its BI system includes the DWH AIDA (Automazione Integrata Dogane Accise), a data management and reporting system collecting the Agency's operational data, matching the printed register.

The AgID page says qualified trust service providers are subject to supervision by competent authorities, 'AgID per l'Italia', and that AgID qualifies trust service providers, which supports the printed statement.

The AgID SIOPE page states electronic orders must pass through the SIOPE+ infrastructure 'gestita dalla Banca d'Italia'; the RGS page says the same of the SIOPE infrastructure. Both quotes are verbatim.

The AgID page defines SIOPE as the infrastructure for electronic monitoring of receipts and payments made by the treasurers of all public administrations, which is exactly the printed statement; the RGS quote on SIOPE+ is also verbatim.

The ANPR site says ANPR is established at the Ministry of the Interior, which relies on Sogei S.p.A. for the technical part; the mission page says implementation is entrusted to Sogei. Both quotes are verbatim and match the printed operator.

The same sentence names BI-Comp as the system performing multilateral clearing of payments to be settled in T2 at national level, matching the printed 'BI-Comp (national multilateral clearing system)'.

Art. 12(1) defines the fascicolo sanitario elettronico (FSE) as the set of digital health and social-care data and documents generated by the patient's clinical events, which supports the printed description; the portal quote is also verbatim.

The page says the only definitive text is the one published in the printed Gazzetta Ufficiale, which prevails in case of discrepancy, exactly as printed.
